endorsements.name: Nicolas Cano
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-40706
endorsements.description: There is no limit on the number of login attempts in the web server for the SNAP PAC S1 Firmware version R10.3b. This could allow for a brute-force attack on the built-in web server login.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.6)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Nicolas Cano
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-40707
endorsements.description: There are no requirements for setting a complex password in the built-in web server of the SNAP PAC S1 Firmware version R10.3b, which could allow for a successful brute force attack if users don't set up complex credentials.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.6)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Nicolas Cano
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-40708
endorsements.description: The File Transfer Protocol (FTP) port is open by default in the SNAP PAC S1 Firmware version R10.3b. This could allow an adversary to access some device files.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.8)

endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.8)
